messages:
nora: Postmortem live for 04/07 tokenizer OOM cascade. Root cause: intermittent tokenizer buffer growth on long prompts + gc lag. Need clear owners for remediation, monitoring, and customer handoff notes. PM wants Jira links in thread.

kevin: I'll take ownership of the fix in tokenization library and regression tests. Will spin up a draft ticket and attach repro.

tasha: I'll own monitoring + alerting + customer runbook updates for Private deployments. Can someone confirm who owns the on-call follow-through?

infra-bot: Noted: recurrence detected across 3 incidents in last 60 days. Tagging as recurrence-pattern.

kevin: Draft tickets: RED-4201 (tokenizer: fix buffer leak + unit tests), RED-4202 (e2e regression with long-prompt harness). Links: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RED-4201

ops-bot: Jira ticket RED-4201 created by kevin. Status: Open.

tasha: Created RED-4203 (monitoring: high-token-buffer alert + dashboard) and RED-4204 (customer runbook: Private deploy mitigation steps). I'll add playbook steps to RED-4204. Link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RED-4203

nora: Proposed RACI: RED-4201 R=Kevin A=Nora C=Tasha I=Platform Eng; RED-4203 R=Tasha A=Nora C=Infra I=Support; RED-4204 R=Tasha A=Customer Success C=Eng-Private I=Security. Agree?

kevin: Agree on RACI. I'll include a short owner-handoff section in RED-4201: how to escalate to Private teams and what artifacts to attach (heap dump, tokenizer config).

tasha: Adding due-dates: RED-4201 2026-04-15, RED-4203 2026-04-09, RED-4204 2026-04-12. Will ping if infra dependency blocks.

nora: Scheduling 20m checkpoint for 2026-04-06. If anyone expects blockers, post here so we can reassign. Also, @kevin please include a concise changelog note for hosted users so we can coordinate a graceful deploy window.

kevin: Will do. Also noting recurrent pattern: similar symptom seen when model context > 32k and upstream batching spikes. I'll add that to RED-4202 repro steps.

infra-bot: Reminder: attach the failing trace ID in all Jira tickets for automatic incident correlation.

nora: Great work team. We'll move day-to-day to the Jira board; reopen here only for cross-team blockers or customer escalations. :white_check_mark:
